title: [ML] fix model snapshot sorting when sorting by min_version

timeline.message: [ML] fix model snapshot sorting when sorting by min_version
timeline.author: Benjamin Trent

timeline.body:
When handling the missing field in sort builder, `Version` shouldn't be added directly, instead a string representation of the version concerned.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/80561
This shows that the deprecation checker should have multi-node tests :(.

Could this fluent builder pattern be used here too?
```
        SearchRequest searchRequest = new SearchRequest(indexName)
            .indicesOptions(...)
            .source(...)
```

reply.body: No necessarily, we use the default indices options created in the request.

timeline.body:
Would it make sense to add an assertion on the result?
Or are we satisfied just knowing it doesn't throw?

reply.body: Previously, it threw a search exception. I am satisfied (for expediency) for now.
